subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved with docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: The central newline insertion path exists through pi-tui today, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would add a new public config or CLI surface that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests and docs.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's shipped newline support as sufficient and intentionally decline docs/help/config follow-up for this issue.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed the remaining product choice on this issue and have the strongest current TUI/docs routing signal.
